shared_elements: large rounded boulder carved in low relief
curvilinear spiral/volute motifs on the upper part of the boulder
large crescent or hook-shaped curved band on the lower body
comb-like row of short parallel strokes
adjacent smaller carved boulders to the right bearing similar relief motifs
justification: Both show the same distinctive carved boulder: a domed rock bearing a concentric ring/eye motif and volutes at the top, a comb-like row of short parallel strokes at centre, and a broad crescent-shaped curved band sweeping across the lower face, with further similarly carved boulders abutting it on the right. The only difference is that B shows the whole group at a distance so the fine relief details are compressed and additional flanking boulders are visible, while A isolates the principal carving in close view.
